request.deadline: 18-month transition and operations period, with milestones from Q3 2026 through 2027
deliverables: Establish or host a not-for-profit entity and kick off transition in Q3 2026
Publish technical transition architecture and migration plan for community review
Hold an on-chain board election under published rules by Q4 2026
Serve all public API traffic for mainnet, preview, and preprod from the new stack by Q1 2027
Legally transfer Blockfrost source code, trademarks, domains, and associated assets to the governing entity
Open public sustainability consultation and publish a long-term sustainability proposal in Q2-Q3 2027
Operate the public API at minimum 99% monthly uptime with quarterly technical and budget reports
request.recipient: Input Output / Blockfrost transition structure, with Intersect/CDH contract administration described in the document
request.what: Transition Blockfrost into a free, community-governed public good under an independent not-for-profit, funding 18 months of transition and operations.

claims.claim: Blockfrost is the number-one hosted platform used by Cardano developers and survey adoption rose from 39.3% in 2022 to 71.5% in 2025.
Blockfrost served 781k unique visitors, more than 1.84 billion API requests, almost 700 requests per second, and over 7 TB of API data last month.
In most Cardano epochs, more than 50% of all transactions are submitted through Blockfrost.
More than 100 Icebreakers have joined the decentralized Blockfrost operator effort.
Ninety percent of Cardano traffic served through the Blockfrost API comes from the free tier, making the current commercial model difficult to use for financing the public-good operation.
The proposal will transfer Blockfrost source code, trademarks, domains, and associated assets into community stewardship under a community-governed not-for-profit.
The not-for-profit board is planned to have five seats, with four for open-source infrastructure development entities and one community seat, after a preliminary board guides formation.
The requested budget is 9,832,979 ADA, calculated from 1,868,266 USD at 0.19 USD per ADA, for 18 months of operations and transition.
The budget allocates 79.1% to staffing for six team members and overhead, 19.3% to operations and infrastructure, and 1.6% to legal and accounting.
The proposal says unspent post-transition infrastructure budget will be returned to the treasury and quarterly reports will include technical data and a budget summary.

summary: The document requests 9,832,979 ADA to fund an 18-month transition of Blockfrost into a community-governed not-for-profit public API, with milestones for entity formation, board election, service migration, IP transfer, sustainability planning, public dashboards, quarterly reporting, and 99% monthly uptime operations.
